purpose: 保存済みの別時点オッズ・予測で159の共通対象を増やせるかの品質・時点・重複監査
official_cohort: 158 snapshot: full started field and saved netkeiba official win payouts confirmed against archived payout HTML; 712 races
decision_time: earliest feasible max(quote captured/created, stored MEV computed, old run/prediction/feature computed/created/updated); must be strictly before post
prediction: stored mev-ens15-v1 plus mix-129-nj6 preweight; original model/training/field/probability checks retained; latest eligible old computation at chosen decision
price_bridge: whole-field canonical horse_id + horse_number + Decimal odds exactly equal saved MEV odds_used; saved p is reused unchanged; matching prices do not prove the quote was consumed by MEV
not_admissible: proxy timestamps relabeled as actual quote capture
same-race/time old run variants counted as new races
different odds substituted into cached MEV
counts: unique races, race-days and (race_id, decision_at) separately; baseline retained; additional source copies deduplicated by ID/time/price/p
settlement: official payout only; no settlement or PnL rerun without newly eligible cohort
verdict: coverage finding only; can_adopt=false, eligible_for_verdict=false, untouched_holdout=false
